reading: After being stabbed by his co-pilot, Captain Smit Machchhar said he opened the cockpit door because he was determined to save others.
He recalled lying injured on the floor as the aircraft, carrying more than 170 passengers, lost height.
"I was lying on the floor injured but I told myself to go for one last push to open the door from inside," he said in a video call with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
People who entered the cockpit also played a role in bringing the situation under control.
Flydubai's flight FZ1073, bound for Tel Aviv from Dubai, plunged more than 17,000ft (5,200m) two and a half hours into its journey.
It first sent an emergency signal to air traffic controllers before switching to code squawk 7500, which indicates hijacking.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later told the media that one pilot had stabbed the other before "apparently trying to crash" the plane.
After fellow passengers overpowered the attacker, two reserve pilots, who were onboard, safely landed the plane at Tabuk Airport in north-western Saudi Arabia.
Machchhar, who has been hailed as a "true hero" by Netanyahu, was taken to hospital before being airlifted to Abu Dhabi, where he is reported to be in a stable condition.
Netanyahu told Fox News the attacker was an Omani national and said investigations suggested he had undergone "Islamist radical indoctrination".
Netanyahu said the attacker had been subdued and tied up before asking the crew to kill him, remarks Netanyahu interpreted as suicidal.
The United Arab Emirates has begun investigating "whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose", according to the country's state news agency.
Indian social media has been awash with praise for Machchhar since his identity emerged.
The Indian Prime Minister told him that "his courage, patience and quick decision-making saved the lives of so many people" and the whole country was proud of him.
The Indian embassy in the UAE said Machchhar was "in good health and recovering well".
"I am not looking at this wound like a wound because that would make my recovery even more difficult," Machchhar said.

vocabulary.definition: To have been involved in or contributed to a particular action or situation.
Transported by aircraft, typically a helicopter, especially from an inaccessible area or in an emergency.
A reported condition that is not changing significantly; it does not by itself mean that the person is well or uninjured.
Experienced or subjected to something, typically something unpleasant, challenging, or transformative.
The process of teaching someone a set of beliefs or principles in a way that is intense, thorough, and often resistant to change, leading to extreme views.
Overpowered and brought under control, typically by force.
Having or expressing the intention of taking one's own life.
Completely covered or overwhelmed with expressions of approval, admiration, or commendation.
The process of making choices, especially important ones, often in a complex situation.
Making good progress in regaining health or strength after an illness or injury.
The process of regaining health, strength, or a normal state after an injury or illness.

entries.ja: 特定の行動や状況に関与したり、貢献したりすること。
entries.ko: 특정 행동이나 상황에 참여하거나 기여한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 参与某个行动或局面，或对它做出贡献。
entries.es: Haber participado o contribuido en una acción o situación particular.
entries.pt-BR: Ter se envolvido ou contribuído para uma ação ou situação específica.
entries.fr: Avoir été impliqué dans ou avoir contribué à une action ou une situation particulière.
entries.de: An einer bestimmten Handlung oder Situation beteiligt gewesen zu sein oder dazu beigetragen zu haben.

entries.ja: 特に近づきにくい場所から、または緊急時に、航空機（通常はヘリコプター）で輸送されたこと。
entries.ko: 특히 접근하기 어려운 지역이나 비상시에 항공기, 주로 헬리콥터로 운송된.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过飞机，特别是直升机，从难以到达的区域或在紧急情况下运送。
entries.es: Transportado por aeronave, generalmente un helicóptero, especialmente desde un área inaccesible o en una emergencia.
entries.pt-BR: Transportado por aeronave, geralmente um helicóptero, especialmente de uma área inacessível ou em uma emergência.
entries.fr: Transporté par aéronef, généralement un hélicoptère, en particulier depuis une zone inaccessible ou en cas d'urgence.
entries.de: Per Flugzeug, typischerweise einem Hubschrauber, transportiert, besonders aus einem unzugänglichen Gebiet oder in einem Notfall.

entries.ja: 大きな変化がないと報告されている容体。それだけで健康である、またはけががないという意味ではない。
entries.ko: 큰 변화가 없다고 보고된 상태. 이 표현만으로 건강하거나 다치지 않았다는 뜻은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 据报告没有明显变化的病情；这本身并不表示当事人健康或没有受伤。
entries.es: Estado que, según lo informado, no cambia de forma importante; por sí solo no significa que la persona esté bien o ilesa.
entries.pt-BR: Condição que, segundo o relato, não apresenta mudanças importantes; isso, por si só, não significa que a pessoa esteja bem ou sem ferimentos.
entries.fr: État qui, selon les informations rapportées, ne change pas sensiblement ; cela ne signifie pas à lui seul que la personne va bien ou est indemne.
entries.de: Ein Zustand, der laut Bericht keine wesentlichen Veränderungen zeigt; das allein bedeutet nicht, dass die Person gesund oder unverletzt ist.

entries.ja: 何かを経験した、または何らかの出来事の対象となったこと。通常、不快なこと、困難なこと、または変革をもたらすことについて使われる。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 경험하거나 겪은 상태. 주로 불쾌하거나 도전적이거나 변화를 가져오는 일에 대해 사용된다.
entries.zh-Hans: 经历过或遭受过某事，通常是令人不快、具有挑战性或带来转变的事情。
entries.es: Haber experimentado o haber sido sometido a algo, típicamente algo desagradable, desafiante o transformador.
entries.pt-BR: Ter experimentado ou sido submetido a algo, geralmente algo desagradável, desafiador ou transformador.
entries.fr: Avoir vécu ou subi quelque chose, généralement quelque chose de désagréable, de difficile ou de transformateur.
entries.de: Etwas erlebt oder durchgemacht haben, typischerweise etwas Unangenehmes, Herausforderndes oder Transformierendes.

entries.ja: ある一連の信念や原則を、集中的かつ徹底的に、そしてしばしば変化に抵抗する形で教え込む過程で、極端な見解につながるもの。
entries.ko: 누군가에게 일련의 신념이나 원칙을 강렬하고 철저하며 종종 변화에 저항하는 방식으로 가르쳐 극단적인 견해로 이끄는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 以强烈、彻底且常难以改变的方式向某人灌输一套信仰或原则的过程，从而导致极端观点。
entries.es: El proceso de enseñar a alguien un conjunto de creencias o principios de una manera intensa, exhaustiva y a menudo resistente al cambio, lo que lleva a puntos de vista extremos.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de ensinar a alguém um conjunto de crenças ou princípios de uma forma intensa, completa e muitas vezes resistente à mudança, levando a visões extremas.
entries.fr: Le processus d'enseigner à quelqu'un un ensemble de croyances ou de principes d'une manière intense, approfondie et souvent résistante au changement, menant à des vues extrêmes.
entries.de: Der Prozess, jemandem eine Reihe von Überzeugungen oder Prinzipien auf eine intensive, gründliche und oft widerstandsfähige Weise beizubringen, was zu extremen Ansichten führt.

entries.ja: 圧倒され、通常は力ずくで制御下に置かれた状態。
entries.ko: 압도되어, 보통 힘으로 제압되고 통제된 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 被制服并被控制住，通常是使用武力。
entries.es: Dominado y puesto bajo control, típicamente por la fuerza.
entries.pt-BR: Dominado e colocado sob controle, geralmente pela força.
entries.fr: Maîtrisé et mis sous contrôle, généralement par la force.
entries.de: Überwältigt und unter Kontrolle gebracht, typischerweise mit Gewalt.

entries.ja: 自分の命を絶つ意図を持っている、またはそれを表明している。
entries.ko: 자신의 목숨을 끊으려는 의도를 가지고 있거나 그것을 표현하는.
entries.es: Que tiene o expresa la intención de quitarse la vida.
entries.pt-BR: Que tem ou expressa a intenção de tirar a própria vida.
entries.fr: Qui a ou exprime l'intention de mettre fin à ses jours.
entries.de: Die Absicht haben oder äußern, sich das Leben zu nehmen.

entries.ja: 承認、賞賛、または称賛の表現で完全に覆われているか圧倒されている状態。
entries.ko: 승인, 감탄 또는 칭찬의 표현으로 완전히 뒤덮이거나 압도된 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 完全被认可、钦佩或赞扬的表达所覆盖或淹没。
entries.es: Completamente cubierto o abrumado por expresiones de aprobación, admiración o encomio.
entries.pt-BR: Completamente coberto ou dominado por expressões de aprovação, admiração ou elogio.
entries.fr: Entièrement couvert ou submergé d'expressions d'approbation, d'admiration ou de louange.
entries.de: Vollständig bedeckt oder überwältigt von Ausdrücken der Zustimmung, Bewunderung oder des Lobes.

entries.ja: 特に複雑な状況において、選択を行う過程。
entries.ko: 특히 복잡한 상황에서 선택을 내리는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 做出选择的过程，尤其是在复杂情况下的重要选择。
entries.es: El proceso de tomar decisiones, especialmente las importantes, a menudo en una situación compleja.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de fazer escolhas, especialmente as importantes, muitas vezes em uma situação complexa.
entries.fr: Le processus de faire des choix, en particulier des choix importants, souvent dans une situation complexe.
entries.de: Der Prozess, Entscheidungen zu treffen, besonders wichtige, oft in einer komplexen Situation.

entries.ja: 病気や怪我の後、健康や体力を取り戻す上で順調に進んでいること。
entries.ko: 질병이나 부상 후 건강이나 체력을 회복하는 데 좋은 진전을 보이고 있는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 在疾病或受伤后，在恢复健康或体力方面取得良好进展。
entries.es: Estar progresando bien en la recuperación de la salud o la fuerza después de una enfermedad o lesión.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer bom progresso na recuperação da saúde ou da força após uma doença ou lesão.
entries.fr: Faire de bons progrès pour retrouver la santé ou la force après une maladie ou une blessure.
entries.de: Nach einer Krankheit oder Verletzung gute Fortschritte bei der Wiedererlangung von Gesundheit oder Kraft machen.

entries.ja: 怪我や病気の後に健康、体力、または正常な状態を取り戻す過程。
entries.ko: 부상이나 질병 후에 건강, 체력 또는 정상 상태를 되찾는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 受伤或疾病后恢复健康、体力或正常状态的过程。
entries.es: El proceso de recuperar la salud, la fuerza o un estado normal después de una lesión o enfermedad.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de recuperação da saúde, força ou de um estado normal após uma lesão ou doença.
entries.fr: Le processus de retrouver la santé, la force ou un état normal après une blessure ou une maladie.
entries.de: Der Prozess, nach einer Verletzung oder Krankheit Gesundheit, Kraft oder einen normalen Zustand wiederzuerlangen.

review.method: Codex multilingual editorial update; unchanged definitions retained after review of their use in the revised reading; no paid translation or new independent model review
